description: Plateau: the flat (constant-triangle) min-triangle surface — Razborov's minimum density held while the co-cherry d1 sweeps, realized by an independent part (size s) joined completely to a triangle-free filling psi of density rho on the rest; up to the Razborov–Lo crease.
provenance: Plateau: Razborov scallop swept along (d1,d2,d3)+=(2,-1,0)·(d1/2), clipped at the crease c*(s,t)=6s(1-ts)(1-(t+1)s)^2/(1-(t-1)s)=(1-(t-1)s)^3*max d1(psi); d3 = Razborov(d). Proven (Razborov bound + Pikhurko-Razborov triangle-free fillings of density rho=2s(1-ts)/(1-(t-1)s)^2).
